sources_summary: 2022 Census microdata (Pessoas file), Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) - own weighted tabulation, weighted by the P0110 sample weight, restricted to population age 10+ (religion was not asked of under-10s).

Cross-checked against IBGE's own published national and state figures in "Censo Demografico 2022 Religioes: Resultados preliminares da amostra" (official report), which states a national "Outras religiosidades" share of 2.7% (2010) to 4.0% (2022), and Roraima as the highest state at approximately 7.8%.
method: IBGE's public 2022 Census microdata sorts religious affiliation into 9 broad groups; "Outras religiosidades" (religion code 6) is a mixed bucket covering every religion outside the 8 other named categories - including Latter-day Saints, Jehovah's Witnesses, Spiritualists, Jews, Muslims, Buddhists, and esoteric traditions, among others. IBGE has not released a more granular 33-category breakout that would isolate any single one of those groups (including LDS) from this bucket, in either the public microdata, the SIDRA agregados API, or the official preliminary-sample report checked for this chart. This chart is NOT an estimate of Latter-day Saint population by state and should never be read as one.
